name: community/freeimage
description: FFI bindings to the native FreeImage library (image load/save across formats) via HostLibs.
residual: Same as fftw: nothing here compiled until HostLibs entered the payload (2026-08-24).
FreeImageUtils is the piece a user actually wants (a FreeImage bitmap as an A2 image) and it is exactly the piece that needs std/gui. It waits for the same package the matrix GUI layer waits for.

excludes.FreeImageUtils: needs Raster (std/gui): it converts to A2 images, which is the point of it, so it belongs with a graphical package
excludes.TestFreeImage: a test program, and it needs Raster as well
